execution-only reward r_exec ∈ {0,1}, group relative policy optimization

LOO ablation protocol — for proved sample with n components, remove each component, re-run solver, ISR = fraction of components whose removal causes proof failure

ISR(x) = (1/n) Σ_i 1[solver fails on x\{c_i}], bounded [0,1]. ISR=1 → all necessary; ISR=0 → none necessary

exec-only, additive ISR (r_exec·(1+β·ISR)), additive random control, convex combination, SFT baseline

- ISR: Intensional Structural Reward
